こんで.es: estar concurrido; abarrotarse (forma て de こむ)
こんで.en: to be concursed; to be abridged (form)

さむく.es: frío; forma adverbial de さむい

bloques.titulo: A-A does not reach the grade of B.
texto: The comparison uses the same adjective or verb in both parts.
(Today is not as cold as yesterday.)
The train is not as full as the bus.

frases.ja: きょう は きのう ほど さむく ありません。
frases.es: Hoy no hace tanto frío como ayer.
frases.en: It's not as cold today as it was yesterday.

frases.ja: でんしゃ は バス ほど こんで いません。
frases.es: El tren no está tan lleno como el autobús.
frases.en: The train's not as full as the bus.
